  chunk_output_type: console

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#Set working directory
setwd("xxx")

#Install pakage "data.table" and invoke the library
install.packages("data.table")
library(data.table)

#Read the Fig.S1D_dat.csv file
MF374_tnseq_dat<-fread("Fig.S1D_dat.csv")

#Invoke libraries ggplot2, dplyr, ggsignif
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsignif)

#Define SampleID nad Vector as characters
SampleID<-as.character(MF374_tnseq_dat$SampleID)
Vector<-as.character(MF374_tnseq_dat$Vector)

#Define number of number of unique barcodes (NMUB) as numeric
NMUB<-as.numeric(MF374_tnseq_dat$NMUB)
Mean<-as.numeric(MF374_tnseq_dat$Mean)
MF374_tnseq_dat_NMUB <- MF374_tnseq_dat %>%
  group_by(Vector) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_NMUB = mean(NMUB, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_NMUB = sd(NMUB, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    sem_NMUB = sd_NMUB / sqrt(n)
  )

mean_NMUB<-as.numeric(MF374_tnseq_dat_NMUB$mean_NMUB)


# Perform the t-test to calculate the p-value
t_test_result <- t.test(NMUB ~ Vector, data = MF374_tnseq_dat)  
p_value <- t_test_result$p.value  

# Create a formatted annotation for the significance  
formatted_annotation <- paste("P =", round(p_value, 3))  # For example: "P = 0.0123" 

#Run gpplot to make barplot
barplot_MF374_tnseq_dat <- ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = MF374_tnseq_dat, aes(x = SampleID, y = Mean, fill = Vector), stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(), width = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(data = MF374_tnseq_dat, aes(x = SampleID, y = NMUB, shape = Vector), size = 4,color = "black",position = position_dodge(0.7),alpha=0.7) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(17, 17)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#0c74b9', '#d55427'))+
   # Explicit position to ensure it's within limits  
  labs( 
    x = NULL,  
    y = "Number of mapped unique barcode",fill= "RB-TnSeq library",shape="RB-TnSeq library"  
  ) +  
  theme_minimal() +  
  theme(  
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),  
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),  
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),  
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),  
    axis.line.x = element_line(arrow = arrow(type = "closed", ends = "last", length = unit(0.25, "cm")), color = "black", size = 1.5),  
    axis.line.y = element_line(arrow = arrow(type = "closed", ends = "last", length = unit(0.25, "cm")), color = "black", size = 1.5),  
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),  
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),  
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),  
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  
    title = element_text(size = 18, color = "black")
  ) +  
  geom_errorbar(data = MF374_tnseq_dat_NMUB, aes(x = Vector, ymin = mean_NMUB - sem_NMUB, ymax = mean_NMUB + sem_NMUB), width = 0.2, size = 1.5, position = position_dodge(0.9))

#Show the barplot
barplot_MF374_tnseq_dat

#Save the barplot as a tiff file
ggsave(filename = "barplot_MF374_tnseq_dat3.tiff", plot = barplot_MF374_tnseq_dat, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300,compression = "lzw")

#Save the barplot as a svg file
ggsave(filename = "barplot_MF374_tnseq_dat3.svg", plot = barplot_MF374_tnseq_dat, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300,device = "svg")

```
